jobs.title: Legal Operations Manager (3-6m Contract)
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. 

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup https://sifted.eu/leaderboards/sifted-future-50-2025 in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben https://www.linkedin.com/in/ben-freeman-a8542166/, Abs https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhirukt/, Sabrina https://www.linkedin.com/in/scastiglione/, and Rebe https://www.linkedin.com/in/rebecatristan/.



FIND OUT MORE ABOUT THE TEAM AND LIFE AT OMNEA HERE https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpjeHyocsu3ZoDn3sfODjqIR2L_DW3dgb. 


OVERVIEW

We're looking for a talented Legal Operations Manager to run a 3-6m project for us and build out the systems, processes and tooling that will let Omnea's Legal function scale at pace as we grow across multiple markets!

Reporting to our Head of Legal for the duration of the contract, you'll own how Legal runs day to day from contracting workflows and legal tech, to intake and triage, templates and playbooks, reporting, and external counsel management. You'll partner closely with Go To Market, Finance, Security and Procurement to make legal a genuine accelerator for the business. This is a rare chance to design a modern, AI-native legal operations function from the ground up.

NB. We're either hiring this role in the UK or the US, so whilst we have an advert open for each location, we have one open headcount.




WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

You'll do whatever it takes to help Omnea operate at pace. You'll:

 - Own and continuously improve our contracting workflows end-to-end, from intake and triage through to signature and storage

 - Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly and safely

 - Own and optimise our legal tech stack evaluating, implementing and managing tools such as contract lifecycle management (CLM), e-signature, entity management and AI

 - Track, measure and report on legal KPIs, matter volumes, cycle times and external legal spend

 - Manage relationships with external counsel and vendors, including budgeting, engagement and performance

 - Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration

 - Partner with Sales, Finance, Security and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes, and help support our infosec certifications




ABOUT YOU

We're looking for someone commercial, systems-minded and energised by building:

 - You have experience in legal operations, ideally at a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

 - You don't need to be a qualified lawyer but you understand how legal teams work and what they need to operate effectively at scale

 - You're an excellent project manager and process designer with a genuine systems mindset. You have a strong bias for automation but also the creativity to imagine novel solutions that others might miss

 - You can map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and redesign processes to drive efficiency.

 - You're hands-on with legal technology across the stackCLM platforms, e-signature tools, contract automation, AI-powered legal tools, workflow systems.

 - You're data-driven and can turn metrics and insights into better decisions.

 - You have a commercial mindset and understand how legal operations directly impact business outcomes, faster deal cycles, reduced risk, better stakeholder experience.

 - You thrive at pace and in ambiguity. You can manage competing priorities, shifting roadmaps, and incomplete information without losing sight of what matters most

 - You're happy to get hands-on and into the detail of whatever needs doing, whether that's building workflows, troubleshooting a CLM integration, training the team, or rolling up your sleeves on contract admin

 - You're an outstanding communicator  in both writing and in person. You can translate between legal, technical, and business stakeholders and make complex operational concepts accessible

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.




A FEW THINGS TO NOTE: 

 - We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here https://www.notion.so/omnea/UK-Benefits-at-Omnea-36c88cce658781c39d08ee947693506f and our US Benefits Package here https://www.notion.so/omnea/US-Benefits-at-Omnea-36c88cce658781b49890e725794c0af1. 

 - We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here https://www.omnea.co/documents/why-omnea-is-not-fully-remote

 - We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here https://www.omnea.co/careers and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here https://news.crunchbase.com/startups/omnea-funding-employees-future-founders-freeman/!

 - We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup https://sifted.eu/leaderboards/sifted-future-50-2025 in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben https://www.linkedin.com/in/ben-freeman-a8542166/, Abs https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhirukt/, Sabrina https://www.linkedin.com/in/scastiglione/, and Rebe https://www.linkedin.com/in/rebecatristan/.



FIND OUT MORE ABOUT THE TEAM AND LIFE AT OMNEA HERE https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpjeHyocsu3ZoDn3sfODjqIR2L_DW3dgb. 




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You’ll be our CEO’s commercial and executional partner -- running special projects that don’t yet have a natural owner, from acquisitions and fundraises to exec hiring, PR, and building out new teams/business lines. It’s a genuinely cross-functional Office of the CEO role, sitting at the intersection of product, GTM, and business building more broadly.

This person will not be a back-office operator. You’re a builder and a doer -- someone who thrives on ambiguity, wants to learn how to run a company from the inside, and can turn ideas into results at speed. It is also not glamorous work: You will need a ‘no job is too small’ attitude and to thrive from executing and making an impact, not strategising.

You’ll get an unmatched view into how a category-defining AI-driven business scales from $10M to $100M+ ARR at great speed, working directly with the CEO and leadership team. It’s the perfect role for someone who wants to be a future founder, GM, COO or commercial leader; compressing 10 years of experience into two.

The spike we’re looking for is commercial judgment and operator muscle, not process. The best candidates will have lived the chaos of a start-up/scale-up and learned how to bring order without slowing things down. You’ll be trusted with some of the most important company initiatives, and your fingerprints will be on some of Omnea’s most strategic moves.

In short: This is the CEO’s right hand on the initiatives that drive growth, visibility, and scale. If you succeed, the company moves faster, hires better, and shows up in the world with the ambition of a generational business.




WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?

You’ll own and deliver CEO-level special projects end-to-end. You’ll take a rough idea, scope it in days (not weeks), and drive to a clear finish line. One quarter that might be running an exec search end-to-end (outreach, screening calls, and all!); the next it could be exploring an acquisition, launching a new GTM motion, or helping unblock a critical customer need.

You’ll drive partnerships and strategic GTM bets. You’ll identify leverage points, pilot new GTM plays, and coordinate across Sales, Product, and Marketing to unlock revenue -- from enterprise lighthouse customer pursuits to ecosystem partnerships.

You’ll lead executive and critical hiring. You’ll source, run, and close senior searches. You’ll build the brief, map the market, run a tight process, and bring elite operators to the table and filter candidates before our CEO speaks with them.

You’ll operate with founder-level ownership, at pace. You’ll decide what matters, what doesn’t, and in what order. You’ll keep momentum through ambiguity, clear blockers, and communicate crisply so busy people can move.

You’ll learn fast and earn trust. You’ll work directly with the CEO and leadership team, gaining exposure to how product, GTM, capital, and hiring intersect -- and you’ll be trusted with all internal company matters.




ABOUT YOU

You’ve likely spent 6–10 years in high-growth companies (ideally B2B SaaS), in roles spanning BizOps, BD/revenue generation, or GM-style leadership. You understand how sales, marketing, and capital decisions drive growth, and you can turn strategy into action without much direction.

You are entrepreneurial and motivated to help build a business, not just observe one. You’re happiest when working hard and solving challenging problems. You know this requires dedication and some sacrifice, and you think it’s worth it.

You have a track record of exceptional performance -- whether in academia, work, or elsewhere -- and evidence of sticking it out through tough environments. You’ve thrived in 0→1 or growth-stage companies, helping to build the playbook while executing it.

You’re commercially minded and can run projects end-to-end: hiring execs, working deals, or launching GTM initiatives. You’ve learned what great execution looks like and bring that standard everywhere you go.

You communicate crisply and with purpose. You can craft CEO-grade narratives -- board decks, competitive positioning, external comms -- and represent Omnea and our CEO with confidence and discretion.

You’re trusted, pragmatic, and able to move quickly when needed. You thrive in ambiguity, act with judgment & taste, and bring momentum to everything you touch.

Dealbreakers: This is not for pure consultants/VCs without operating experience. It’s not for people who need heavy structure, or who want process over progress. If you don’t get energy from being in the weeds & making an impact (often requiring unglamorous work), you will not enjoy this role.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.




A FEW THINGS TO NOTE: 

 - We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here https://www.notion.so/omnea/UK-Benefits-at-Omnea-36c88cce658781c39d08ee947693506f and our US Benefits Package here https://www.notion.so/omnea/US-Benefits-at-Omnea-36c88cce658781b49890e725794c0af1. 

 - We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here https://www.omnea.co/documents/why-omnea-is-not-fully-remote

 - We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here https://www.omnea.co/careers and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here https://news.crunchbase.com/startups/omnea-funding-employees-future-founders-freeman/!

 - We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

FIND OUT MORE ABOUT THE TEAM AND LIFE AT OMNEA HERE https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLpjeHyocsu3ZoDn3sfODjqIR2L_DW3dgb. 




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You’ll be our US GM Arie’s https://www.linkedin.com/in/abarendrecht/ commercial and executional partner, working closely with our CCO’s CoS Liat https://www.linkedin.com/in/liatfainman/, to own problems that don’t yet have a natural home: growing our GTM team without lowering the bar, leveraging our VC and angel network to build a community, ramping new hires fast, and deciding which markets we build next. It sits at the intersection of GTM, Ops and Talent.

This isn’t a back-office role. You’re a builder who thrives on ambiguity and turns ideas into results at speed — and it won’t always be glamorous: you’ll need a ‘no job is too small’ attitude and energy for execution over strategising.

You’ll get an unmatched view into how a category-defining AI business scales from $10M to $100M+ ARR, working closely with our leadership team — the kind of role that compresses 10 years of founder, GM, or COO experience into two.

We’re looking for commercial judgment, first-principles thinking, and speed at scale — the instincts of someone who’s lived start-up chaos and knows how to bring order without slowing things down. You’ll be trusted with some of Omnea’s most important initiatives, with your fingerprints on our most strategic moves.




WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?

The role will evolve as you ramp up and will involve your parachuting into different areas of the business to build & run them. Currently the most pressing need is building our US Growth engine.

Scaling & Hiring (core focus during first 6-12 months)

 - You'll build the machine that helps us identify the top 1% of talent and close them - diagnosing the funnel, running the experiments, and owning the number to 3x our sales headcount

 - You'll build and own our comp benchmarking model — the difference between losing candidates to banking and consulting, and actually landing them

 - You'll rebuild our people process from the ground up, sitting in on interviews to diagnose exactly where signal breaks down and building the rubric that gets our bar genuinely aligned

 - You'll shape how Omnea shows up in the US market — through podcasts, events, our VC network — so the best people in New York already know who we are before we ever reach out

AI, Enablement & Ramp

 - You'll own the ramping target — building the onboarding that turns a hire into a top performer in weeks, not months

 - You'll build the collateral, tooling, and process that shortens time-to-ramp and becomes the playbook other teams end up borrowing

 - You’ll figure out ways to automate the process end to end so the team can scale efficiently

Strategic Projects & Market Expansion

 - You'll oversee strategic decision like where we expand to next in North America — working with our CFO and RevOps team to make the case with real data, not guesswork

 - You'll build the reporting that gives GTM leadership a clear, unfiltered view of what's actually working, shaping how we operate over the next 12 months




ABOUT YOU

We’re looking for a commercial powerhouse and inspiring leader to take Omnea overseas to the APAC and through its next phase of growth. As our founding APAC GM, you’ll be responsible for APAC market build and driving revenue growth — driving our biggest deals, as well as building the teams and playbooks, that take us from strong traction to market leadership.

This is a unique opportunity to a GTM leadership position at Omnea, which will be reporting to the CCO & CEO. You’ll own regional revenue growth and processes, talent development, and represent Omnea in high-stakes customer conversations with CFOs, COOs, and procurement leaders at some of the world’s largest companies. You’re passionate about being hands-on and directly driving deals, scaling a high-performing sales organisation, coaching our team into world-class managers, and driving consistent execution across the region. Taking ownership of our APAC expansion, you’ll create the blueprint for global expansion; your work will set the standard for how Omnea scales internationally.

You’ll set the commercial strategy for the region by partnering with our CEO & CCO on GTM strategy; expanding Omnea’s ICP & verticals and spearheading nuances required to win in APAC.

 - Represent Omnea externally and be hands-on in the field.
   
   You’ll take on the role as Omnea’s exec sponsor across a lot of core deals in the region. You’ll represent us as the regional face at industry events, analyst briefings, and customer roundtables, building trust and recognition for Omnea’s category-defining vision. You’ll work directly on high-stakes deals with CFOs, COOs, and Procurement leaders at enterprise customers — setting the tone for what “great” looks like in every engagement.

 - Drive operational excellence & GTM performance
   
   By partnering with Marketing, Partnerships and RevOps you’ll ensure every part of our machine is aligned for growth. You’ll architect the APAC outbound engine with CAs, partners, and analyst influence. You’ll embed rigor into forecasting, pipeline management, territory planning, deal reviews and process execution — creating a culture of discipline, data, and excellence. You’ll own APAC revenue targets with accurate forecasting, run pipeline and deal reviews to ensure quality, velocity, and disciplined execution (MEDDPIC).

 - Influence Product expansion with APAC customer insight
   
   Deeply understand APAC enterprise stacks and buying environments, and turn field signal into clear product requirements and prioritisation. Drive integration gaps and workflows across customer tech stack and adjacent tools. Champion APAC security, compliance, and data‑residency expectations so we build the right things for the APAC market.

 - Build & lead a world-class team.
   
   You’ll recruit, coach, and inspire exceptional GTM leaders — empowering them to build high-performance teams across sales. You’ll hands-on help your team navigate complex sales cycles with the world’s leading mid-market and enterprise tech businesses and coach them to become sales leaders at Omnea and in their careers. You’ll build a high-performing culture of accountability, collaboration, and excellence.


ABOUT YOU

You’re an enthusiastic seller, strategic operator and a world-class people leader, with the energy and executional intensity of a founder.

 - You’re not afraid to be in the weeds, get your hands dirty and directly drive deals but you’re also passionate about coaching your team to do their best work. You get on airplanes at EOQ, together with your team

 - 10+ years of experience in B2B SaaS leadership, with 3+ years leading regional GTM or P&L functions. You have a track record as an enterprise sales IC as well as a leader, where you’re known for being hands-on, not a RevOps dashboard manager

 - You understand hustle & complexity, ideally you’ve had experience selling challenger products in tough environments. Proper enterprise deals (100k+) with lots of stakeholders and project management (not PLG/ usage-based, mid-market/high volume)

 - Proven track record of building, scaling, and leading high-performing commercial teams across multiple markets (early stage to growth). Strong ability to recruit, coach, and retain an A+ sales team. You know what exceptional talent looks like, have hired and ramped them into high-performing salespeople before.

You’re a natural communicator and can get on well with anyone. You have the gravitas and executive presence to sell to senior leadership (ideally into CFOs, Legal or Procurement)

Above all: You’re ambitious, commercial, collaborative, and care deeply about building something exceptional. You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and have an almost obsessive sense of ownership and entrepreneurship; whether it’s in academia, work, sport, sales, or founding something of your own

THE ROLE

We're hiring the first dedicated owner of Omnea's performance marketing.

You're not starting from scratch. Paid campaigns, the website and our social channels all exist (and are working to varying degrees). But nobody's job is to work out what actually produces pipeline and then make more of it. That's this role: take what's already running, find the ROI, and professionalise it into something we can be proud of.

In one week you might work out why a paid campaign is generating leads that never convert, rebuild the landing page that's losing them, build a new LinkedIn audience off the back of our closed-won data, and show the exec team what the pipeline picture looks like.

If you want to run one channel and hand-off the numbers, this might not be for you. If you want to own the loop from spend through to pipeline, and have the data to prove what worked, it is.

You'll work closely with our digital agency partners, the field marketers running events in the UK and US, and the sales team who rely on the pipeline you generate.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Pipeline and performance

You'll build the picture of what marketing is actually returning, and you'll be the person with the answer when someone asks whether a channel is worth the money.

 - Own the pipeline number for our digital channels: how much, from where, and at what cost

 - Build and maintain dashboards in Dreamdata using sources like HubSpot and GA4

 - Track campaigns from first touch through to closed won, and use what you find to change what we run next

 - Run a proper testing cadence. Set the test, call the result, and stop the things that aren't working

 - Report on what the numbers mean, not only what they are

Paid

You own paid. Our agency handles campaign build and optimisation, and you set the direction they work to.

 - Act as day-to-day partner to the agency: set the brief, shape audience strategy and funnel design, and decide together what to test next and how to deploy 6-figure annual ad spend.

 - Own LinkedIn as our primary paid channel: audiences, target account lists, retargeting and sequencing

 - Build audiences from our own data: closed-won patterns, target accounts, product signals  - rather than off-the-shelf targeting

 - Work with content and design teammates to produce compelling content

 - Make the case for more budget when the numbers justify it

Website and conversion

 - Own conversion across the site: forms, journeys, page structure, and what happens after someone clicks an ad

 - Build and update pages using our existing component library and CMS

 - Run an ongoing testing programme on the pages that matter, and work with the in-house design team on what comes next

 - Ship landing pages for campaigns and product launches, including forms and tracking

 - Keep tracking and attribution clean, so the reporting can be trusted
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience in a B2B marketing role, in-house or agency. We care more about what you delivered than where you did it.

 - You're commercial. You think in pipeline and cost per opportunity, not clicks and impressions, and you can tell the difference between a campaign that's busy and one that's working.

 - You know paid mechanics properly. Audiences, match rates, attribution windows, frequency. LinkedIn Ads specifically.

 - You're comfortable with numbers. You can build a report from scratch, spot when something looks wrong, and explain a trend to someone who wasn't in the weeds with you.

 - You've built pages in a CMS. Not from scratch in code — assembling pages from components, keeping them consistent, and getting the tracking right.

 - You've worked with or inside an agency, so you know how to write a brief and how to tell good work from work that's merely on time.
   
   

Nice to have

 - Comfortable in tools like HubSpot, Dreamdata, Google Ads, Campaign Manager

 - B2B SaaS, ideally selling to finance, procurement, legal or risk

 - SEO fundamentals

 - Enough Figma to work sensibly with designers
   
   


WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE IN SIX MONTHS

 - We know what every pound of adspend returns, and everyone trusts the number

 - Paid is producing pipeline we can attribute, at a cost we're happy to scale

 - Our LinkedIn audiences are built from our own data rather than off-the-shelf targeting

 - The pages that carry the most traffic have been tested and improved

 - You're the person the exec team asks when they want to know whether a channel is working
